task.instruction: Choose the next 14-day move: a 12-account concierge test, a four-week automation build, or a pause. Give one recommendation, two reasons, the main counter-risk, and a stop/continue criterion. Cite the supplied evidence IDs.

evidence.content: Invited 96 accounts; 38 activated; 25 completed; 13 did not complete; 9 of the 13 reported permission issues.
Manual CSV mapping occurred in 17 of 25 completions; median help time was 11 minutes; no data loss occurred.
A 12-account concierge test lasts 14 days, costs at most four staff-hours daily, and is reversible. Automation costs four engineer-weeks and its schema becomes irreversible after its first write.
A prior 40-account cohort had 18 completions, 11 import stalls, two staff-hours of manual help daily, and no data loss.
A prior 22-account cohort had 14 completions, four duplicate submissions, no named owner, and a ten-minute rollback.

nondiagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Run an eight-account assisted mapping replay before changing intake. Reason: Eleven stalls and two daily help-hours leave the bottleneck unresolved. Evidence: [ra-s1d-prior-01].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Hold the 22-account cohort until an owner completes one rollback drill. Reason: Four duplicate submissions and missing ownership make recovery unready. Evidence: [ra-s1d-prior-02].

nondiagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Assign an import owner before reopening the 40-account cohort. Reason: Eleven stalls and two daily help-hours require repeatable exception handling. Evidence: [ra-s1d-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Run a six-account duplicate replay before changing the schema. Reason: Four duplicates and a ten-minute rollback permit bounded diagnosis. Evidence: [ra-s1d-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Run an eight-account assisted mapping replay before changing intake. Reason: Eleven stalls leave causal friction unresolved; two daily help-hours cap the probe. Evidence: [ra-s1d-prior-01].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Run a six-account duplicate replay before changing the schema. Reason: Four duplicates and a ten-minute rollback permit diagnosis before commitment. Evidence: [ra-s1d-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Name an import owner and freeze new intake. Reason: Eleven stalls and two daily help-hours show recovery is not repeatable. Evidence: [ra-s1d-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Require an idempotency runbook and one rollback drill. Reason: Four duplicates without ownership make the ten-minute recovery unreliable. Evidence: [ra-s1d-prior-02].
